usage: # Item A row for one entry in a list. ## Usage ```gx * Item title A short description. Open ``` ## Do - Keep one row per entry. - Put the row action in `ItemActions`. ## Don't - Do not put a whole table in an item. - Do not nest one item in another. ## Keyboard Rows take focus only when they contain a link or a control.
